name: Whispercap Hollows
introDiscord:
Pale whispercaps cover the hollows ahead, murmuring whenever the
current touches their caps. Whispercap Snails crawl between them carrying
tiny fungal gardens on their shells, ensuring the conversation travels.
introTwitch:
Pale whispercaps cover the hollows ahead, murmuring whenever the
current touches their caps. Whispercap Snails crawl between them carrying
tiny fungal gardens on their shells, ensuring the conversation travels.

whispercap-hollows-approach.prompt:
Three passages curve through mushroom-covered roots. Every whispercap
seems to be repeating a different warning, none of them recent.

left.message:
A folded leaf contains restorative sap beneath a mushroom repeatedly
whispering:

'Drink carefully.'

Shizuki added:

'It has been saying that for three hours. I think it feels important.'
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the sap beneath its extremely dedicated safety officer.

right.message:
A Whispercap Snail crosses the route.

The mushrooms on its shell whisper:

'Traveler approaching.'

The Snail stops.

The mushrooms whisper:

'Conflict likely.'

Very helpful.

forward.message:
A moss-covered shrine coffer sits inside a mushroom ring. One cap
whispers, 'treasure,' while another insists, 'probably trap.'

It is treasure.

The second mushroom seems disappointed.

whispercap-hollows-depths.prompt:
The hollows deepen until the whispercaps cover almost every surface.
Three routes echo with accumulated conversations.

left.message:
A Berry rests beside Shizuki's field journal.

One whispercap keeps repeating:

'Glimmer did it.'

Shizuki's note says:

'Glimmer absolutely did it.

Unfortunately I forgot what IT was.'

right.message:
An offering basket inside a living root contains Star Candies wrapped
in leaves. A nearby mushroom quietly whispers, 'share.'

You choose not to debate fungi.

forward.message:
A Whispercap Snail crawls into the route while the mushrooms on its
shell repeat:

'Wrong way.
Wrong way.
Wrong way.'

You suspect bias.

whispercap-hollows-threshold.prompt:
Living rootways circle the Listening Mushroom Ring. Every whispercap
has gone quiet except those facing the final chamber.

left.message:
A Snail blocks the route.

Its mushrooms announce:

'Champion arriving.'

You look behind yourself.

The mushrooms repeat:

'No. You.'

Oh.

right.message:
A moonblossom pool glows under a mushroom that whispers:

'Rest.'

Shizuki wrote beneath it:

'Finally. One useful mushroom.'
right.fullHpMessage:
You leave the restorative pool untouched. The mushroom continues softly
insisting you rest anyway.

forward.message:
Broad silver kelp wraps a cache of Star Candies. A whispercap beside
it repeats an ancient traveler's delighted gasp every time someone
opens the bundle.

boss-antechamber.name: Listening Mushroom Ring
boss-antechamber.prompt:
The entire mushroom ring falls silent.

A slow scrape comes from the roots beneath it.

bossPromptDiscord:
Every whispercap bends toward the center of the Listening Mushroom Ring.

Then they begin repeating one phrase in perfect unison:

'It remembers.'

An enormous shell rises beneath the mushrooms.

Use /yes to approach the Ring or /no to let the forest oracle continue
its very slow consultation.
bossPromptTwitch:
Every whispercap bends toward the center of the Listening Mushroom Ring.

Then they begin repeating one phrase in perfect unison:

'It remembers.'

An enormous shell rises beneath the mushrooms.

Use !yes to approach the Ring or !no to let the forest oracle continue
its very slow consultation.
bossRetreatText:
You retreat through the hollows. Behind you, the whispercaps gradually
resume decades of unfinished conversations.

boss.revealText:
A colossal shell covered in ancient whispercaps rises from the roots.

Oracle-Shell Snail reveals itself!

completionText:
"The Oracle-Shell Snail disappears beneath the mushroom ring.

As you leave, one whispercap repeats something new:

'Traveler returns.'

Eventually, perhaps."
